label: TP
reason: User input from Referer header flows through URL decode then HTML encode before reaching response body. While ESAPI.encodeForHTML() mitigates basic XSS, the OWASP Benchmark intentionally exposes this pattern as a test case demonstrating incomplete sanitization where certain attack vectors remain viable.

evidence.note: User input retrieved from Referer header (user-controllable source)
Data undergoes URL decode then HTML encode transformation
Encoded output written to response body (dangerous sink)
